FIELDS.NAME: Paws & Claws Pet Emporium
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Paws & Claws Pet Emporium, we specialize in providing a welcoming and well-organized retail environment for pet lovers. Our core operations focus on the sale of high-quality pet food, accessories, and supplies, catering primarily to common domestic animals such as dogs, cats, and small mammals. In addition to our retail services, we offer professional grooming services performed by trained staff who have documented experience in animal handling and grooming techniques.

We create a safe and enjoyable experience for both pets and their owners by ensuring our facilities are equipped with secure animal enclosures, non-slip flooring, and proper ventilation in grooming areas. Our grooming salon requires appointments to maintain efficient service, allowing us to keep detailed records of all services performed.

We are committed to animal welfare and adhere to all local regulations, ensuring a clean and safe environment. Our staff undergoes regular safety training to enhance their skills and knowledge. Our goal is to foster long-term relationships with our customers by encouraging responsible pet ownership and providing products and services that prioritize the health and happiness of their pets.
